# Rakit UI

> Rakit UI (Dart package `rakit_ui`, version 0.1.0, MIT) is a set of composable Flutter widgets for checkout, host-owned authorization, payment status, receipts and optional KYC. The widgets render structured data from the host app and report intent through callbacks. The package is UI only: it moves no money and processes no payments. It targets iOS and Android phones and tablets; the web build is a docs preview only.

Install and import:

```sh
flutter pub add rakit_ui
```

```dart
import 'package:rakit_ui/rakit_ui.dart';
```

Requires Dart ^3.12.0 and Flutter >=3.44.0 (tested with Flutter 3.44.6 stable). Register `PaymentLocalizations.delegate` together with the Material and Cupertino delegates from `flutter_localizations`. English and Indonesian strings are included.

Rules the kit keeps:
- The host owns network, clipboard, URL launching, camera, routing, auth, pricing, KYC decisions, payment status, idempotency and polling. The kit makes no network or platform-channel calls. It holds no secrets and has no dependency other than the Flutter SDK.
- An unknown or timed-out payment is never shown as failed or paid. Only host snapshots change the status.
- Styling order: PaymentTheme / PaymentType / PaymentMotion, then a family theme (PaymentButtonTheme, PaymentFieldTheme), then a host preset, then a one-off `style`. Fields have no instance `style`. Do not invent variants, preset APIs or API names; check the component page's Props table or the generated API data.
- Touch targets are at least 48 dp, and layouts work at 200% text on 320 dp. With reduced motion on, the kit runs no animation.

## Start
- [Introduction](https://rakit-ui.netlify.app/start/introduction/): what the kit owns and what the host keeps
- [Installation](https://rakit-ui.netlify.app/start/installation/): pub.dev install, SDK requirements, git or path dependency for development
- [Quick start](https://rakit-ui.netlify.app/start/quick-start/): a complete lib/main.dart, then fragments from quote to receipt
- [Try it](https://rakit-ui.netlify.app/start/try-it/): run the checkout recovery demo or try the kit in a fresh app
- [Host-owned decisions](https://rakit-ui.netlify.app/concepts/host-owned/)
- [Payment attempt and status](https://rakit-ui.netlify.app/concepts/payment-attempt/)
- [Theming](https://rakit-ui.netlify.app/concepts/theming/)
- [Accessibility](https://rakit-ui.netlify.app/concepts/accessibility/)

## API
- [Component catalog](https://rakit-ui.netlify.app/components/): one page per component, with a Props table
- [Blocks](https://rakit-ui.netlify.app/blocks/): complete host screens with copyable source
- [Patterns](https://rakit-ui.netlify.app/patterns/checkout/): checkout, status and receipt, history, verification (KYC)
- [Dart API reference on pub.dev](https://pub.dev/documentation/rakit_ui/latest/)
- [Public exports](https://github.com/naufaldi/flutter_ui_payment/blob/main/lib/rakit_ui.dart)
- [Generated API data (JSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/naufaldi/flutter_ui_payment/main/website/src/data/api.json): every exported class, constructor and parameter, generated from the Dart source

## Examples
- [Example app](https://github.com/naufaldi/flutter_ui_payment/tree/main/example): the demos shown in the docs, with a fake host and synthetic data
- [Checkout recovery demo](https://rakit-ui.netlify.app/blocks/checkout-recovery/): a lost submit response recovered without offering a second payment
